title: The Shy Snow Woman and the Cursed Ring TV Anime Reveals Early Streaming on September 11 on OceanVeil, Promo Video, Opening Theme Song
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of artist Puuzaki Puuna 's (also known as Puu no Puupuupuu or Zeroshiki Kōichi) adult dōjin manga The Shy Snow Woman and the Cursed Ring ( Hitozukiai ga Nigate na Mibōjin no Yuki Onna-san to Noroi no Yubiwa ) announced on Friday that the series will stream early on AnimeFesta on September 11 at 5:00 p.m. JST. WWWave Corporation 's anime streaming platform OceanVeil announced that it will stream the anime on the same day. The staff also revealed an NSFW visual (different from image below) for the premium streaming version and a promotional video. The video reveals and previews the opening theme song "Choux Cream" (Cream Puff) by Hitomi Suzune.

The anime will premiere on television in Japan on October 4 on BS11 and October 6 on Tokyo MX .

The anime stars:

• Harumichi Shidō as Satoru Takahashi

• Rikka Kitami as Mifuyu Yukino

• Sara Ayumi as Kaede Kiryuin

The staff includes:

• Director: Kazuomi Koga

• Series Compositor: Eeyo Kurosaki

• Character Designer: Minakyawa Akapiv

• Chief Animation Director: Miyako Nishida

• Color Designer: Chika Yanagisawa

• Art Setting: Chan Do Kim Fan

• Art Director: Chan Do Kim Fan

• Director of Photography: Hououin Shurakura

• Editing: Kōki Shinkai

• Sound Director: Mikumo Amakuwa

• Sound Producer: Studio Mouse

• Animation Production: Studio Hōkiboshi

• Production: Suiseisha

Puuzaki Puuna claimed in the original announcement that this would be the first time an adult dōjin manga is adapted directly into a TV anime without first having a separate commercial version (though there are numerous anime adaptations of adult dōjin manga into long-running adult anime, but they are all OVAs). Puuzaki Puuna revealed in a comment that the television anime will have an original story different from the original manga.

The manga so far has two all-color volumes. Irodori Comics released both ( Warning: Links are NSFW ) volumes of the manga in English.

The manga centers on a landlord who find a ring that can control creatures such as yōkai, and he uses it on a snow woman living in one of the apartments.

title: My Girlfriend's Friend Anime Main Trailer, New Visual, Cast, October 4 Premiere
content:
My Girlfriend’s Friend anime revealed the main trailer, along with new cast, visual, and an October 4, 2026 premiere. The TV anime adaptation of Jura’s manga w and third key visual have also been released, along with additional cast details. Studio Quad ( My Life as Inukai-san’s Dog ) was previously confirmed for the animation production. The series will be released in both an On-Air Version and a fully uncensored “Complete Deregula Version.”

The newly announced cast members are Riho Sugiyama as Miyuki and Ryoka Yuzuki as Kaori’s mother. Known members now include:

• Ryuga Nagaike as Takeru Hidaka

• Sayaka Hashi as Kaori Koga

• Miki Hase as Tomoko Yoshida

• Riho Sugiyama as Miyuki (NEW)

• Ryoka Yuzuki as Kaori’s mother (NEW)

Airots performs the opening theme “Gingira,” with lyrics by Occhoko Bunny and composition and arrangement by Kotaro Odaka and Saeto Kato. Ceui performs the ending theme “False Love,” written by UiNA and composed and arranged by Kotaro Odaka and Takayuki Ishikura. You can watch the new trailer below.

The anime’s official X account also unveiled the third key visual, as well as a planned Blu-ray release.

My Girlfriend’s Friend follows Takeru, who gets his first girlfriend, Kaori, only to find himself increasingly drawn into a dangerous relationship with her friend Tomoko. Takashi Ando is directing the anime at Quad. The full staff credits include:

• Director: Takashi Ando

• Script and Series Composition: Goko Shiraki

• Chief Animation Director: Akira Koshiishi, Konatsu Kumagai, Masayuki Fujita

• Sound Director: Hiroki Nishiyama

• Editor: Junichi Masunaga

• Director of Photography: Makoto Togo

• Animation Producer: Naoto Awano

• Character Designs, Chief Animation Director: Ryuji Iwata

• Producer: Takafumi Suzuki
author: Anime Corner

title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster Game Heads West
content:
NIS America announced on Friday that it will release The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster ( Shinigami Hime to Ishokan no Kaibutsu ) game in the West for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam in 2027. The company unveiled an announcement trailer:

The game launched on Switch, Switch 2, and PS5 in Japan on April 30.

The fantasy side-scrolling adventure game features a picture book aesthetic and storytelling style. The story centers on Mono (voiced by Rena Motomura ), the child of a family that runs an opera house. Mistreated and cast aside, she does chores for her family around the opera house, and lives in the attic, loved only by her beloved older sister ( Reina Kondo ), who teaches her of opera and dance. One day, her sister is infected with a virulent disease known as Paper Mortis (Shinigami-byō) that eventually turns all it infects into a picture book, and eventually into a horrific "paper monster." The disease seems to greatly affect teenage girls in particular. The state has given up on curing it, and instead confines patients into facilities known as Asylum Libraries, where they are allowed to waste away.

With her sister confined in one such facility, Mono sets out toward it, desperate to do the impossible: to find a way to reverse her sister's disease. Within the Asylum Library, she finds it overrun with paper monsters, and filled with strange warps in reality: manifestations of the picture books that patients have turned into, expanded into a bizarre realm that contains their memories and traumas. Mono encounters a legendary paper monster named Mär ( Makoto Koichi ), with whom Mono forges an uneasy alliance. Mär is keen on exacting revenge against the human race for a past grievance, but will protect Mono as she navigates the Asylum Library and the picture book worlds in search of her sister.

Kento Jobana ( Phantom Brave: The Lost Hero , Disgaea 7 ) directed and wrote the game. Illustrator Sayaka Oda ( The Cruel King and the Great Hero , The Liar Princess and the Blind Prince ) was the character designer and illustrator for the game. Takeshi Matsumoto ( The Cruel King and the Great Hero , The Liar Princess and the Blind Prince ) composed the music for the game. Akiko Shikata , known for her work in the Ar Tonelico series, performs the game's theme song. Shikata also performed songs for The Cruel King and the Great Hero and The Liar Princess and the Blind Prince .

title: Tokyo Anime Awards Festival Ends
content:
TAAF launched in 2014 as an independent festival and has had 13 iterations. It was an evolution of the Tokyo Anime Award, which was part of the Tokyo International Anime Fair from 2002-2013.

TAAF's X (formerly Twitter ) account and YouTube channel will shut down on September 30. Its website will become an archival site from September 30 onward.

The festival honored Kenshi Yonezu with an award for Best Sound/Performance in the Anime of the Year division this year. It recognized four of Yonezu's theme song contributions to anime over the past year: "Plazma" from Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX , "Bow and Arrow" from Medalist , and "Iris Out" and "Jane Doe" from Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc . "Jane Doe" is a collaboration with Hikaru Utada .

Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX won the television category and Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle - Akaza Sairai, the first film in the Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle trilogy , won the animated film category.

The judges chose from titles that debuted in whole or in part between October 1, 2024 and September 30, 2025.

title: New Votoms Anime Films Reveal Cast
content:
The official website for Sunrise and Production I.G 's Sōkō Kihei Votoms Haiiro no Hexe ( Armored Trooper Votoms : Die Graue Hexe or literally, Armored Trooper Votoms : The Grey Witch), the two new anime films in the Armored Trooper Votoms franchise , revealed on Friday the anime's cast, character designs, and a 30-second trailer:

The cast includes (English romanization not confirmed):

Miyuki Sawashiro plays Ash Vamps (left in visual above), a notorious and feared AT pilot called the Grey Witch. Mabuki Andou plays Maki Stauffenberg (right), an officer secretly assigned to look into Ash's past.

The staff includes:

• Original Character Design Concepts: Kazuchika Kise (xxxHOLiC, Made in Abyss, Fate/Grand Order The Movie Divine Realm of the Round Table: Camelot)

• Character Design: Shingo Ogiso, Takashi Kojima, Tetsuya Nishio

• Original Mechanical Designer: Kunio Ōkawara

• Mechanical Design: Jū Ishiguchi, Wataru Inada

• Costume Design Assistance: Katsuya Terada

• Art Design: Satoshi Takabatake, Yasumitsu Suetake, Kazushige Kanehira

• Art Director: Yūshi Honjō

• Color Key Artist: Nagisa Abe

• Compositing Director of Photography: Yūki Kawashita

• CG Directors: Yōta Tasaki, Toshihisa Yokoshima, Jō Nakajima

• Editing: Aya Hida

• Sound Director: Kazuhiro Wakabayashi

Mamoru Oshii is directing the two films. Ryōsuke Takahashi , director and creator of the original concept for the original 1983 Armored Trooper Votoms anime, is supervising the film. Shinobu Tsuneki ( The Legend of the Galactic Heroes: Die Neue These , Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex , Kaiju No. 8 ) and Sōkō Kihei Votoms: AT Stories manga artist Yoshiro Sōno are the mechanical designers. Kenji Kawai , who has worked with Oshii in various projects including Ghost in the Shell and Patlabor 2: The Movie , is composing the music.

The 1983 Armored Trooper Votoms anime is an iconic entry in the so-called "real robot" subgenre of mecha pioneered by Mobile Suit Gundam , characterized by robots as mass-produced military machines (with limitations in operation akin to real-life war machines) and gritty and grounded stories about war and its bitter costs.

The original 1983 anime is set during the ebb of a century-long conflict between the two nations of the Gilgamesh Confederation and the Balarant Union. The unit that dominates the battlefield is the VOTOMS (Vertical One-man Tank for Offense & Maneuvers), a class of powerful yet extremely vulnerable mecha , known as much for their firepower as they are for the high casualty numbers of their pilots due to thin armor and lack of safety measures. The protagonist, Chirico Cuvie, is a member of an elite Gilgamesh VOTOMS unit that becomes a pawn in a vast conspiracy that brands him a traitor to Gilgamesh, and leads him to cross paths with a mysterious woman.

Section23 Films ' Maiden Japan label most recently released the original anime on Blu-ray Disc in 2019 and 2020.

The original series has inspired a number of spinoff anime, including Armored Trooper Votoms: The Last Red Shoulder , Armored Trooper Votoms: Big Battle , Armor Hunter Mellowlink , Armored Trooper Votoms: Red Shoulder Document - Roots of Treachery , Armored Trooper Votoms: Pailsen Files , Armored Trooper Votoms: The Heretic Saint , and Armored Trooper Votoms: Alone Again . Armored Trooper Votoms: Alone Again , the latest entry in the series until now, debuted in 2011.

title: Crunchyroll’s Biggest Isekai Already Has a Finale Date For Latest Season
content:
Over the years, the isekai genre keeps expanding more and more, with at least a few series each quarter. However, even among the endless stream of such popular series, Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World stands out as one of the best in the industry. Not to mention that it is the most popular isekai anime on Crunchyroll, the largest streaming platform for anime fans across the globe. Based on a light novel written by Tappei Nagatsuki and illustrated by Shinichiro Ootsuka, the anime is commemorating its 10th anniversary since its debut.

The anime keeps rising in popularity with each season thanks to its dark themes and unique premise. Not only that, but 2026 is the biggest year for fans after Season 4 adapted the most intense arcs in the anime so far. The latest season premiered in April this year as part of the Spring 2026 anime lineup. Now that the Fall 2026 anime season, the final quarter of the year, is only a month away, Re:Zero will also conclude the fourth season.

When Is Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 Ending?

The latest season is scheduled for 19 episodes, and so far, 15 episodes have already been released. The final episode of Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World Season 4 will air on September 30th, 2026. While the latest season wasn’t officially split into two cours like Season 3, the anime took a few weeks of hiatus after the Loss Arc ended in Episode 11. The anime returned with new episodes on Crunchyroll to adapt the Recapture Arc. However, unlike the previous episodes, the English dubbed episodes weren’t released simultaneously for the Recapture Arc.

The dubbed episodes were delayed for two weeks , so if you are watching the anime only in English, then the final dub is expected to be released on October 14th, 2026. The light novel is still ongoing, so we can expect the anime to continue even after Season 4. Thanks to its popularity, we might expect an update on Season 5 after the fourth season’s finale or at least before the end of the year.

What’s Happening in Re:Zero − Starting Life in Another World- Season 4?

Season 4 features the most intense arcs in the anime so far , as each episode keeps bringing more plot twists for fans. The anime has never shied away from high stakes, tragedy, and overwhelmingly dangerous situations, but even by those standards, both arcs were way more intense than what fans are used to. Subaru Natsuki was forced to witness his friends die in gruesome ways, forcing him to realize his weakness and the gravity of the situation.

After the ordeals he went through in the first part, he is more than ready to fight alongside his friends in the battle against the Sin Archbishop of Gluttony. We can expect the Recapture Arc to wrap up in Season 4, after which the story will continue in the upcoming seasons, bringing a new set of challenges for Subaru and his friends.

title: Additional Cast for 'Romelia Senki' Announced
content:
The official website for the Romelia Senki ( Romelia War Chronicle ) television anime announced 14 additional cast on Friday. The anime series adapting Ryou Ariyama 's action fantasy light novel will air for two cours on Tokyo MX, BS11, Sun TV, and KBS Kyoto in October 2026.

Cast Hans: Hiromichi Tezuka ( Kill Ao ) Grain: Tomohiro Yamaguchi ( Saikyou no Ousama, Nidome no Jinsei wa Nani wo Suru? ) Jini: Ryuuichi Hirose ( Kingdom 3rd Season ) Tarth: Kenta Hosoda ( Re:Monster ) Sei: Tasuku Kaito ( The Fable ) Zeze: Rikuya Yasuda ( Koori no Jouheki ) Brai: Hiroki Matsukawa ( Marriagetoxin ) Ben: Taiki Yamashita ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: GQuuuuuuX ) Gatt: Souhei Horikane ( Saigo ni Hitotsu dake Onegai shitemo Yoroshii deshou ka ) Rett: Naoki Sakurai ( Bukiyou na Senpai. ) Shuro: Mizuki Ishii ( Kami no Tou: Koubou-sen ) Meryl: Hayato Kimura ( Dead Account ) Borel: Shuntarou Hara ( Kikaijikake no Marie ) Micha: Hiromu Mineta ( Arne no Jikenbo )

Hiroshi Shirai ( Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero episode director) is helming the anime at Atra . Aya Satsuki ( Kawaisugi Crisis ) is handling the series composition and penning the script. Yoshiko Saitou ( Towa no Yuugure ) and Yuuta Ootaka ( Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu 3rd Season animation director) is designing the characters. KOHTA YAMAMOTO ( Dark Gathering ) is composing the music.

Ariyama originally began penning the action fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in August 2019. Shogakukan began printing the title under its Gagaga Books label in June 2020, featuring illustrations by Kodama . The sixth volume shipped in November 2025.

Ryou Kamito began drawing a manga adaptation on the Manga Doa app in April 2021. Mag Garden released the fifth volume in November 2025.

title: Hellbound Artist Kyoo-seok Choi Teams Up With MEEN for New Webtoon Crocodile
content:
Kakao Entertainment announced on Friday that Crocodile , a new action noir webtoon created by MEEN and Hellbound artist Kyoo-seok Choi, will launch on Kakao Page on September 5.

The series marks the first collaboration between the two creators. It follows In-hoo Jung, who is released from prison after serving 10 years for murder. Hoping to live a quiet life, he instead becomes entangled with the family of the man he killed when the victim's wife asks him to protect her son.

Set in Busan, Crocodile explores revenge, redemption, and the meaning of life as In-hoo confronts the family of his former victim. The series combines action with a gritty noir atmosphere and detailed character-driven storytelling.

MEEN is known for action noir works including Tong , Blood Rain , and the Dokgo series. MEEN's Crime Puzzle and Price of Violence series are both available on Tapas .

Choi co-created the webtoons Hellbound with director Sang-ho Yeon.

Fans can read Hellbound on WEBTOON .

title: 'Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. Season 2' Reveals Additional Cast, New Staff, Theme Songs, Third Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nigojuu 's Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. ( The Detective Is Already Dead ) revealed additional cast, new staff, the theme songs and third promotional video for the second season on Friday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 7 at 9.30 p.m. on AT-X, followed by Tokyo MX, and BS Nippon Television.

Voice actors Akari Komiyama and Nobuhiko Okamoto ( Sousou no Frieren ) are joining the cast as Mia Whitlock and Scarlet, respectively.

Staff Director: Manabu Kurihara ( Medalist chief animation director) Series Composition: Deko Akao ( Noragami ) Character Design: Yousuke Itou ( Kawaikereba Hentai demo Suki ni Natte Kuremasu ka? ) Art Director, Background Art: Haruka Miyata ( Medalist 2nd Season ) NEW Color Design: Eiko Nishi ( Tokyo Ghoul:re ) CG Director: Shouta Tsukuda ( Granblue Fantasy The Animation CG assistant) NEW CGI Producer: Satoshi Iijima NEW Director of Photography: Ayumi Itakura ( Majo no Tabitabi ) NEW , Yuusuke Yamamoto ( Uzaki-chan wa Asobitai! Double ) NEW Offline Editing: Masato Yoshitake ( Shingeki no Kyojin: The Final Season ) NEW Animation Producer: Yuutarou Hoshino ( Unnamed Memory ) NEW , Yuuichi Yasuda ( Unnamed Memory Act.2 ) NEW Sound Director: Nobuyuki Abe ( Kemono Friends ) NEW Music: Yuuyu ( Shiyan Pin Jiating ), 40mP ( Blue Archive the Animation ) NEW Studio: ENGI

Note: The staff denoted with the legend NEW are new in their respective roles .

Singer Koume is performing the opening theme "Kono Shinzou ni Hanataba wo". VTuber and illustrator Nana Kagura is performing the ending theme "Hakuchuumu." Both theme songs are previewed in the third promotional video below.

Produced by ENGi, the first season aired in 12 episodes in Summer 2021, roughly adapting the first second volumes. Crunchyroll streamed the anime with subtitles and dubs in multiple languages.

Nigojuu began penning the mystery romance comedy light novel, also known by its short name Tanmoshi , under MF Bunko J imprint in November 2019, featuring illustrations by Umibouzu . Kadokawa published the 13th volume in July 2025, with the 14th volume scheduled for an October 23 release. Tanmoshi has over 1 million copies of its volumes in circulation since July 2022.

Mugiko began drawing a manga adaptation in Comic Alive magazine in May 2020. Kadokawa published the sixth and final volume in October 2023. The manga series covered the first and third volume of the light novel.

A second manga adaptation by Poni , titled Tantei wa Mou, Shindeiru. The Lost Memory began in the same magazine in January 2021. Kadokawa published its fourth and final volume in November 2022. This manga series covered the second volume of the light novel.

A spin-off light novel written by Syusui Tsukimi , with illustrations by Hanekoto , titled Natsu na Nagisa wa Mada, Mesukousei de Itai. ( Nagisa Natsunagi Still Wants to Be a High School Girl was published by Kadokawa in August 2023. Its second and final was released on February 24. Yen Press licensed the spin-off and published the final volume on February 26.

A second spin-off light novel Charlotte wa Tada, Jiken wo Tokitai. written by Hinachihoko, with illustrations by Minori Chigusa was published by Kadokawa in May 2024. A third spin-off light novel Saikawa Yui wa Demo, Aidoru de Iru written by Shao Senlin, with illustrations by Almic was published by Kadokawa in August 2024.

Yen Press licensed both the light novel and manga in English in January 2020 and April 2021 , respectively. The 12th light novel volume was released on August 11. The sixth manga volume went on sale in December 2024. The company also licensed the spin-off and published the final volume on February 26.

title: WEBTOON's Parent Company Naver Invests in Emmy-Winning Animation Studio Baobab Studios
content:
Naver Ventures, the U.S.-based venture investment arm of NAVER, the parent company of WEBTOON Entertainment, announced on Wednesday it has made a strategic investment in Baobab Studios ( Namoo, Crow: The Legend, The Witchverse ), the 10-time Emmy-winning transmedia animation studio.

The partnership will also bring Baobab and WEBTOON together on SHINE (working title), an original fantasy adventure webcomic created by Oscar-nominated filmmaker Erick Oh ( Opera, Namoo ) and webtoon creator Madeleine Rosca ( Rise From Ashes ).

SHINE is set in a futuristic Korea where the balance between the human and spirit worlds has been shattered. The story follows a half-human girl who must bridge the divide between the two worlds to save Korea.

Baobab is developing SHINE as a webtoon with WEBTOON , alongside a print graphic novel from First Second Books , an imprint of Macmillan Publishers. Baobab will retain the film, television, streaming, and gaming rights to the property as it expands the IP across multiple formats.
